title: Chapter 486
paragraphs: Chapter 486
Episode 135. Brotherhood United (3)
Cough, cough!
Dephus's dismayed fake cough echoed throughout the barracks.
"What did you say?"
Thinking his ears might have deceived him, he asked again, and the answer came.
"I said, let's kill the second-generation knight in this mission."
Kill Joshua.
Dephus had never heard such a thing in his life. Even in her prime, Meri had never said anything like that.
'I've always thought this, but he's really insane...'
And he was terrifying as well.
'He's not the kind of guy to speak thoughtlessly. When he said to kill Joshua, it means he's already finished planning.'
Dephus couldn't quickly figure out what basis the newcomer had for planning to kill Joshua, but it gave him chills.
"You have a knack for surprising people. Why do you want to kill him? It can't be because he jokingly called you the Black Prince, can it?"
"Of course, that's not the reason, but I didn't find it very pleasant."
"Joshua might have thought your title was genuinely cool. When he was young, he liked his own nickname, the Black Lion, the most. He said it felt like succeeding his mother."
Jin and Dephus shared a light laugh.
"I didn't know the second-generation knight had such a cute side."
"You would have found him even more adorable if you had spent your childhood together. Anyway, will you reject my proposal?"
As Dephus composed his expression and asked, Jin shrugged his shoulders.
"Is there a reason to?"
"Once the infiltration of the underground construction site begins, all the executioners in the Sota Desert will return to their families."
"Because anyone below the level of a Black Knight would be unable to retreat after infiltration."

"That's right. Therefore, the personnel directly carrying out the mission are you, me, Lord Murakan, the second-generation knight you want to kill, and his two Black Knights. It means that each person is valuable to complete the mission."
At that, Jin sighed.
"You talk as if we unknowingly walked into a trap set by Ziepl in this secret construction site in the Sota Desert, brother."
Dephus's eyes narrowed.

"In the best-case scenario, this mission can only achieve half success at most. Safe return after facility destruction would be the best result. Ship blueprints? Do you think Ziepl would have left such a thing behind while deliberately leaking the location of this place? There would be absolutely nothing important in areas 4, 11, 17, and 19 either."
The purpose of Ziepl leaking the location of the secret construction site in the Sota Desert.
That was a problem Dephus had been pondering all along. Even though he knew it was a trap, they had entered because the stakes were too high, but it was difficult to grasp what Ziepl's purpose was.
'Does the youngest have any idea of Ziepl's purpose? He's serious about killing Joshua, but what's his real intention?'
As Dephus was about to ponder, Jin opened his mouth again.
"Stop hesitating and make a choice. Will you join me in killing Joshua or not? I'll give you 5 seconds. After that, even if you change your mind, I'll do it on my own. 5, 4."
"Hey, hey, youngest! Wait a moment!"
In the end, Dephus nodded his head before Jin finished counting.
He felt dragged along, but if he didn't negotiate with the youngest now, he had a strong intuition that he would only struggle in vain during this mission.
More than anything, it was an opportunity.
The second-generation knight, the opportunity to 'definitely' kill his older brother, whom he had wanted to kill all his life. Dephus knew that Jin would achieve what he had said.
"Damn it, fine! Let's do it together."
"A beautiful moment of brotherly unity. You won't regret it."
Looking at Jin's smiling face, Dephus cursed inwardly, thinking there was no separate devil.
"But, there's a condition."
"Please, tell me."
"Share all the information you know with me."
"For example?"
"Information about Joshua's accomplice, the so-called prophet, your thoughts on Ziepl's purpose, and the reason for wanting to kill Joshua."
"Is that all?"
"Yes."
"I'll tell you the first one after the mission is over. In return, I'll tell you the second and third right now. In my opinion, Ziepl's purpose is to check the capabilities of external forces."

"Ziepl's purpose is to verify the power of external forces using this construction site as bait? Isn't that a bit far-fetched? I can't even grasp the extent of the manpower and resources invested in this facility."
"You might think that. But you've probably been pondering Ziepl's purpose as well. Do you have a more plausible reason than what I just said?"
There wasn't one.
Dephus was also aware of the principle that 'there is no full-scale war as long as there is a debate,' so he was even more deeply troubled.

"Especially, Ziepl would have needed to check Joshua's capabilities. Specifically, he would have wanted to see if Joshua and his mother truly possess the power to protect the family in place of his father. The world's strongest swordsmanship family. Hasn't the time come when we can't survive on such a name alone?"

The mysterious power of Kinzelo's leader, the chaotic power possessed by Bubar, the master, the empire's mine, Zipl's biological golems and mass-produced flying ships and space-time devices, and history manipulation.
In such a situation, Runcandel was holding on with just a single sword. At least that's what had been revealed so far.

"Therefore, from the moment we start infiltrating, Zipl has already achieved part of its purpose. Without the power of the prophet, it wouldn't have been possible to create such a perfect infiltration route."
"I get it. Then what's the third? What is the purpose of killing the 2nd generation, let alone how to do it? How does the death of the 2nd generation benefit the family?"
Although he was asking, Diphus had already reached his own conclusion.
The impact that Joshua's death would have on the family, if any.
'If the youngest and I kill the 2nd generation during this mission, the family will inevitably split. That's when we need to clean up and reorganize.'
He would sweep away the rotten Runcandel of Rosa and Joshua.
That was Diphus' idea of reorganization.
After Jin revealed the existence of the "legacy of the first generation" to the family through Mary.
The brothers, especially Diphus and Mary, no longer respected Rosa's favoritism. The premise that 'Rosa always makes decisions for the family' was broken.
From that moment on, Rosa's favoritism was the main culprit in destroying the family in Diphus' eyes.

'Of course, the utility of Joshua and mother hasn't completely disappeared. After the cleanup, we need to settle things with our mother. After all, the existence of the prophet is not under Joshua's control but practically under the control of our mother.'
What's next?
The remaining generations continued to fight for the throne and sought the legacy of the first generation to restore the former glory of Runcandel.
They had to break the curse that bound the family and enter the brilliant era of the magic sword that Jin briefly showed.
Although they were fighting for the throne, Diphus agreed with Jin's declaration of returning to the magic sword.
It seemed Jin could clearly see the pictures Diphus was painting now.
Those series of thoughts seemed to be in good shape.

'The picture Diphus is thinking about is close to the royal road. The problem is that Joshua would never have sent his real body to such a dangerous place. Diphus doesn't know that fact, so he thinks it's a great opportunity to change the family and just accepts my proposal as if he's being drawn to it.'
Hiding a bitter smile inside, Jin met Diphus' eyes.

"It feels like getting a test graded, second brother. What benefits will it bring to the family? Cutting off the rotten bond of favoritism and purifying the family is the opportunity. Even if Joshua is killed, the prophet will still be under our mother's control, so we can decide how to use that ability later."
Diphus' eyes widened.
He felt a strange sense of kinship at the fact that Jin had the same thoughts as him. It was just a pity that the youngest was not his perfect ally like Mary.
"Second brother, to be honest, I didn't plan on making this proposal to you. I thought I could kill Joshua on my own. But sister Mary insisted. She asked that we do it together and return safely."
"Mary, making an unexpected request. It's creepy. Were you ever the type to be moved by such lukewarm words?"

"Well, not really, but I'm human too. Sometimes I want to feel family affection, and sometimes I want to repay the kindness of my blood relatives. So, just in case I hurt you in the process of killing Joshua, I wanted to let you know in advance. It just so happens that our goals are the same."
That was sincere.
"Is that enough?"
Difus nodded and reached out his hand to Jin.
"As you say, a beautiful moment of temporary brotherly unity."
As Jin shook his hand, he felt a slight pang of guilt for the first time in a while.
'Well... even if it's the death of a clone, ultimately, it will benefit the family, so Difus will have to understand.'
Even if he didn't understand, by the time the incident was over, it would only make Difus look foolish.
As long as everything went according to Jin's plan.
"Now, let's talk about the plan to kill him. There will undoubtedly be many variables, so let's put our heads together and reduce the problems before we infiltrate."
February 28, 1800, 2 a.m.
As the execution knights cleared the barracks and withdrew, the operation began.
Jin, Murakan, Difus, Joshua, and two black knights. The remaining six people, wearing infiltrating uniforms, ran through the underground of the Sota Desert.
That underground was a tunnel connecting the site of the barracks to the secret construction site, which Joshua had formed in advance using the power of the prophet.
And as soon as they reached the entrance of the construction site after running silently for a while,
The group encountered an unexpected scene.
"...It looks like those rats used our tunnel first."
Joshua spoke while looking at something round on the floor. When they checked the human head and face, it turned out to be one of the construction site managers.
"It seems to be Kinzelo, Second Generation."
The moment the black knight said that.
Boom-!
From beyond the tunnel, the sounds of something breaking and bursting began to be heard.
"...It seems like those beasts are causing trouble."
Joshua spat out the words as he glanced beyond the tunnel.
